newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BRUSSELS BOURSE SURGES TO NEW HIGH AT START.
newsitem.headline: BRUSSELS BOURSE SURGES TO NEW HIGH AT START.

text.p: 0810 GMT - Brussels blue chip Bel-20 Index surged to new life high at start of trade on Monday as wave of merger mania continues to sweep bourse.
* Bel-20 index up 4.15 points, 0.21 percent, at 2,271.93. Eight issues up, seven lower, five unchanged

* Bank Kredietbank leading Bel-20 gainer, up 225 francs, 1.58 percent, 14,425 francs on news that parent Almanij, to acquire Gevaert assets, and on continued speculation about talks with Dutch Rabobank.
* Insurer Royale Belge up 60 francs at 9,980 francs on speculation ahead of AGM on Wednesday.
